_comment: Every outbound platform URL on the site is read from this file. Never hardcode a
URL into page HTML. affiliateUrl is null until the real referral link is pasted in;
tools/affiliate.py swaps them in one command and the pages pick it up on rebuild.
monetizable:false drives the visible no-commission callout — it is generated from

products.name: GoHighLevel
products.commissionNote: 40% recurring, plus 5% second tier. The dashboard states no fixed term — it is not capped at 12 months the way Make and n8n are.
products.pricingModel: Flat monthly per account, unlimited sub-accounts on higher tiers
products.trial: 14-day standard trial. Extended-trial claims are UNVERIFIED — do not state a length without testing the link.
products.bestFor: Agencies and service businesses that want CRM, pipelines, email/SMS, booking, funnels and reporting billed as one product instead of six.
products.weakness: It is a platform, not a connector. If your work is moving data between arbitrary APIs, GoHighLevel is the wrong shape and you will end up bolting Make or n8n onto it anyway.

affiliateProgram.cookieNote: 90-day last-click window. Cancelled customers stay attributed to the original affiliate for 30 days after cancellation.
affiliateProgram.payoutSchedule: Monthly, Net-15 — earned in month N, paid on the 15th of N+1
nonCommissionable: Wallet/usage spend (SMS, email, voice, AI tokens) — contract language is scoped to subscription products. Assume nothing is earned on usage.
AI Employee Growth ($50/mo) — earns nothing; only AI Employee Unlimited ($97/mo per location) qualifies
Self-referrals — explicitly banned as fraudulent activity; risks termination and forfeiture of unpaid commissions
affiliateProgram.qualifyingNote: Verbatim: a purchase is a Qualified Purchase only if the customer clicks your link, completes a NEW purchase, and maintains the account in good standing for at least 45 days. It does not qualify if the account is paused at ANY point in that window.
affiliateProgram.clawback: Unlimited in the contract text — deductible from future commissions on cancellation, refund or chargeback.
affiliateProgram.engagementRequirement: HARD PAYOUT GATE. After your SECOND referred customer you must have a live conversation with a HighLevel team member about affiliate practices before you can receive additional commission payouts. Failure to complete it may result in delayed or forfeited payouts.

disclosureRules.placement: At the top of the post, BEFORE the main content. Not in a footer.
goodWording: I earn a commission if you buy through my link.
disclosureRules.perPost: Every post or video needs its own disclosure.
disclosureRules.video: Must be spoken aloud AND shown as superimposed text near the start. Description-only is insufficient.

affiliateProgram.competitorRule: If you comment on HighLevel competitors, make clear you are not speaking for HighLevel and keep it truthful and fair. No misleading or disparaging statements made to promote HighLevel.
affiliateProgram.keepCurrentRule: Contractual: if something you have said about HighLevel becomes inaccurate, correct or remove it promptly. This is why every price on the site carries a checked date.
prohibited: Brand in domain names or social media handles — this is why noderow.com is brand-independent
Self-referrals — using your own link for yourself or your business is 'fraudulent activity'
Offering discounts, coupons, promo codes, free trials, prizes or other incentives without express written authorisation
Contests, sweepstakes or giveaways referencing HighLevel without prior written approval
Cookie stuffing, forced redirects, cookie-setting pop-ups, masked referral URLs
Representing HighLevel as a franchise or business opportunity; income guarantees

default.use: Generic mentions where no specific plan or offer is in view.

pricing.use: Reader is comparing plans — lands on all three plans and annual pricing.

annual.use: Reader has chosen annual billing (Starter or Unlimited).
annual.note: Stored without the www subdomain in the dashboard. Kept verbatim.

saas-pro.use: Reader is heading for the $497 SaaS Pro plan. DIFFERENT affiliate id.
saas-pro.note: Distinct from the main campaign's /protrial path, which uses id ...30. This campaign explicitly covers Pro SaaS plans.

ai.use: AI-feature context. Note AI Pay-Per-Use and AI Growth earn nothing.

bootcamp.use: HighLevel's own Bootcamp offer page. Link to it as their promotion; do NOT claim a specific extended trial length — that is unverified, and offering incentives without written authorisation breaches the program policies.

certification.use: Certification program ($97/mo or $970/yr). DIFFERENT affiliate id.

products.name: Zapier
products.commissionNote: No public cash affiliate program. NodeRow earns nothing from Zapier, ever.
products.bestFor: Teams who need the widest app catalogue in the industry and whose volume is low enough that per-task pricing never bites.
products.weakness: Cost at volume. Per-task pricing that is fine at 1,000 runs is punishing at 100,000.

products.name: Make
products.commissionNote: 35% for 12 months. Clock starts at registration, not first payment.
products.bestFor: Visual multi-step workflows with branching, where per-operation pricing beats Zapier's per-task pricing at volume.
products.weakness: Operations are counted per module run, so a loop over 500 rows is 500 operations. Easy to underestimate.

products.name: n8n Cloud
products.commissionNote: 30% for 12 months, 90-day cookie. Cloud only — self-hosted pays nothing.
products.bestFor: Teams who want per-execution rather than per-step pricing, and the option to drop into code when the visual nodes run out.
products.weakness: Steeper learning curve than Make or Zapier. Expression syntax and item-vs-batch handling are where new users lose a day.

products.name: n8n self-hosted
products.commissionNote: Self-hosted n8n pays no commission. NodeRow earns nothing when you self-host.
products.pricingModel: Free software, you pay for the server
products.bestFor: Anyone comfortable running a container who wants unlimited executions for the price of a small VPS.
products.weakness: You own uptime, upgrades, backups and credential security. That is real work, not zero.

products.name: Keap
products.commissionNote: Not enrolled. NodeRow earns nothing from Keap.
products.bestFor: Small service businesses that want CRM and email in one place with a gentler learning curve than GoHighLevel.
products.weakness: Per-contact pricing scales against you, and there is no agency sub-account model.

products.name: ActiveCampaign
products.commissionNote: Not enrolled. NodeRow earns nothing from ActiveCampaign.
products.bestFor: Marketing automation depth — segmentation and lifecycle email that most all-in-one platforms only approximate.
products.weakness: Email-first. Booking, funnels and client sub-accounts are not in the box.

products.name: Pipedream
products.commissionNote: Not enrolled. NodeRow earns nothing from Pipedream.
products.bestFor: Developers who want to write real Node or Python between steps without leaving the workflow.
products.weakness: Assumes you can code. Non-technical operators will not get far alone.

products.name: Activepieces
products.commissionNote: Not enrolled. NodeRow earns nothing from Activepieces.
products.bestFor: Open-source alternative to Zapier with a friendlier builder than n8n.
products.weakness: Smaller connector catalogue. Check your specific apps before committing.

products.name: Pabbly Connect
products.commissionNote: Not enrolled. NodeRow earns nothing from Pabbly.
products.bestFor: Buyers who want a one-time lifetime price instead of a subscription.
products.weakness: Builder is less refined and the connector catalogue is thinner than Make's.

products.name: Latenode
products.commissionNote: Not enrolled. NodeRow earns nothing from Latenode.
products.bestFor: Workflows with heavy AI steps, where charging by execution time beats charging per step.
products.weakness: Younger product. Fewer battle-tested connectors.

products.name: Albato
products.commissionNote: Not enrolled. NodeRow earns nothing from Albato.
products.bestFor: Teams wanting embedded integrations inside their own product.
products.weakness: Less known, smaller community, fewer worked examples to copy.

products.name: Integrately
products.commissionNote: Not enrolled. NodeRow earns nothing from Integrately.
products.bestFor: One-click ready-made automations for common app pairs.
products.weakness: Ceiling is low. Complex branching logic is not its strength.

products.name: Lindy
products.commissionNote: Not enrolled. NodeRow earns nothing from Lindy.
products.bestFor: Email and meeting agents that need to act, not just draft.
products.weakness: Less deterministic than a wired workflow. Not what you want on billing.

products.name: Gumloop
products.commissionNote: Not enrolled. NodeRow earns nothing from Gumloop.
products.bestFor: Data-heavy AI workflows — scraping, enrichment, classification at list scale.
products.weakness: Credit burn is hard to predict before you have run it on real volume.

products.name: Relay.app
products.commissionNote: Not enrolled. NodeRow earns nothing from Relay.app.
products.bestFor: Workflows that need a human approval step in the middle, done well.
products.weakness: Smaller catalogue than Make or Zapier.

products.name: Flowise
products.commissionNote: Open source. NodeRow earns nothing from Flowise.
products.bestFor: Self-hosted LLM chains and RAG when you want to own the stack.
products.weakness: You are the ops team. Same trade as self-hosted n8n.

products.name: Dify
products.commissionNote: Not enrolled. NodeRow earns nothing from Dify.
products.bestFor: Building an LLM app with retrieval, prompts and logging in one place.
products.weakness: Overlaps awkwardly with a real automation tool if you already run one.

products.name: Trigger.dev
products.commissionNote: Not enrolled. NodeRow earns nothing from Trigger.dev.
products.bestFor: Background jobs written in TypeScript with real retries and observability.
products.weakness: Code only. This is not a tool you hand to an ops person.

products.name: Windmill
products.commissionNote: Open source. NodeRow earns nothing from Windmill.
products.bestFor: Turning scripts into internal tools with a UI and a scheduler attached.
products.weakness: Developer ergonomics first, non-technical usability second.

products.name: Inngest
products.commissionNote: Not enrolled. NodeRow earns nothing from Inngest.
products.bestFor: Durable event-driven functions with step-level retries in your own codebase.
products.weakness: Not a workflow builder. There is no canvas to hand a client.

products.name: Vapi
products.commissionNote: Not enrolled. NodeRow earns nothing from Vapi.
products.bestFor: Programmable voice agents wired into an existing backend.
products.weakness: Per-minute cost adds up fast on long calls. Model it before launch.

products.name: Retell AI
products.commissionNote: Not enrolled. NodeRow earns nothing from Retell AI.
products.bestFor: Phone agents for booking and qualification with less wiring than Vapi.
products.weakness: Less control over the call stack than a programmable provider.

products.name: Hetzner
products.commissionNote: Not enrolled. NodeRow earns nothing from Hetzner.
products.bestFor: Cheapest credible VPS for self-hosted n8n.
products.weakness: EU-centric regions. Support is documentation, not hand-holding.

products.name: DigitalOcean
products.commissionNote: Not enrolled. NodeRow earns nothing from DigitalOcean.
products.bestFor: Self-hosting with better docs and more regions than Hetzner.
products.weakness: Costs roughly double Hetzner for equivalent specs.

products.name: Railway
products.commissionNote: Not enrolled. NodeRow earns nothing from Railway.
products.bestFor: Getting self-hosted n8n running without touching a Linux box.
products.weakness: Usage pricing is less predictable than a fixed VPS.

products.name: Render
products.commissionNote: Not enrolled. NodeRow earns nothing from Render.
products.bestFor: Managed container hosting with persistent disks for n8n data.
products.weakness: Free tier sleeps, which breaks scheduled workflows.
